================================================================================
empty switch
================================================================================
void foo() {
	switch (69) {}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (literal_int)
		body: (switch_body)))))

================================================================================
switch with one empty case
================================================================================
void foo() {
	switch (69) {
		case 1:
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (literal_int)
		body: (switch_body
			(switch_case label: (literal_int)))))))

================================================================================
switch with multiple empty cases
================================================================================
void foo() {
	switch (69) {
		case 1:
		case 2:
		case 3:
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (literal_int)
		body: (switch_body
			(switch_case label: (literal_int))
			(switch_case label: (literal_int))
			(switch_case label: (literal_int)))))))

================================================================================
switch with one case
================================================================================
void foo() {
	switch (69) {
		case 1: break;
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (literal_int)
		body: (switch_body
			(switch_case
				label: (literal_int)
				(break)))))))

================================================================================
switch with multiple case, fallthrough case and default branch
================================================================================
void foo() {
	switch (69) {

		case 1:
		case 2:
		b++;
		break;

		default:
		c++;

	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (literal_int)
		body: (switch_body
			(switch_case label: (literal_int))
			(switch_case
				label: (literal_int)
				(statement_expression (expression_suffix (identifier)))
				(break))
			(default_case (statement_expression (expression_suffix (identifier)))))))))


================================================================================
switch with a statement before the first case
================================================================================
void f(int g) {
	switch (g) {
		int p = 0;
		case 1: break;
		default: break;
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) (formal_parameters (formal_parameter type: (type_int) name: (identifier))) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (identifier)
		body: (switch_body
			(decl_variable type: (type_int) name: (identifier) init: (literal_int))
			(switch_case label: (literal_int) (break))
			(default_case (break)))))))


================================================================================
switch without a case label
================================================================================
void f(int g) {
	switch (g) {
		if (x) y = 1; else y = 0;
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) (formal_parameters (formal_parameter type: (type_int) name: (identifier))) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (identifier)
		body: (switch_body
			(if
				condition: (identifier)
				consequence: (assignment lhs: (identifier) rhs: (literal_int))
				alternative: (assignment lhs: (identifier) rhs: (literal_int))))))))


================================================================================
case after default
================================================================================
void f(int g) {
	switch (g) {
		case 1: return 1;
		default: return 2;
		case 2: return 3;
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) (formal_parameters (formal_parameter type: (type_int) name: (identifier))) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (identifier)
		body: (switch_body
			(switch_case label: (literal_int) (return (literal_int)))
			(default_case (return (literal_int)))
			(switch_case label: (literal_int) (return (literal_int))))))))


================================================================================
default twice
================================================================================
void f(int g) {
	switch (g) {
		default: break;
		default: break;
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) (formal_parameters (formal_parameter type: (type_int) name: (identifier))) body: (block
	(switch
		subject: (identifier)
		body: (switch_body
			(default_case (break))
			(default_case (break)))))))
